title: Kissed Moroccan Briouat
description: A weeknight Moroccan dish featuring a delicate balance of flavors and textures, easily made with a few simple ingredients.

ingredients.name: Walnut oil
ingredients.notes: Smoked or infused for added depth

ingredients.name: Kosher salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Grated ginger
ingredients.notes: Freshly grated for the best flavor

instructions: Spread a phyllo square with a small amount of walnut oil, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle a pinch of cumin, coriander, and kosher salt over the oil.
Place a few pieces of crispy preserved lemon on one half of the phyllo square, leaving a small border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the phyllo square over the filling, pressing gently to seal, and brush with a little more walnut oil.
Repeat with the remaining phyllo squares and filling ingredients.
Brush the tops of the briouat with a little extra walnut oil and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving, dusting with confectioners sugar and garnishing with chopped parsley.
